items.title: Pierre Céré: Meet the man trying to save the NDP’s only seat in Quebec
items.excerpt: On Dec. 7, Canadians in six ridings, including two in Montreal, will head to the polls to elect their new MPs.

items.title: The kids are not alright: the youth unemployment problem in Canada
items.excerpt: According to the 2026 federal budget, Canada’s youth unemployment rate has hit 13.7 per cent this year.

items.title: I don’t like waiting
items.excerpt: I was getting ready to head to the store to grab some things I needed. It was early in the morning; I was going to arrive at the store ten minutes before it opened and I didn’t mind waiting.

items.title: QUICKSPIN: Lil Baby — FRESH
items.excerpt: Lil Baby’s studio albums have failed to garner much attention, and it has never been clearer than on his latest record.

items.title: QUICKSPIN: Dove Cameron — FINAL GIRL
items.excerpt: Dove Cameron’s second studio album, FINAL GIRL, is her most confessional record yet. Vulnerability takes the stage in multiple forms as she explores the different makeups of the cinematic final girl…

items.title: QUICKSPIN: Rex Orange County — Dream Fatigue
items.excerpt: On his 6th studio album Dream Fatigue, Rex Orange County explores unrequited love and insecurity. The record is an ode to the beauty and messiness that comes with romance.

intro: Pour ouvrir la journée, The Concordian publie « Pierre Céré: Meet the man trying to save the NDP’s only seat in Quebec », sous la plume de Samuel Vandenberg. À lire aussi : « The kids are not alright: the youth unemployment problem in Canada » et « I don’t like waiting » dans The Concordian. Côté sport étudiant, prochain rendez-vous le jeudi 19 novembre à 18 h : Rouge et Or (ULaval) visite Gaiters (Bishop’s).
